# Stickyy 1.2.7
## More control without losing the minimal feel
- Turn on a live word or character count for either note window. - Use the compact **B**, *I*, and underline controls in the menu-bar scratchpad and floating note. Formatting is saved with the note. - Optionally pin important Clipboard Pills. Pinned items stay in place while the remaining pill slots continue to update, and clearing the shelf leaves pinned items untouched. - The floating note now shows one compact clipboard icon and accepts copied text only. - Long notes remain correctly aligned and scroll smoothly while you type.
These options are available in Stickyy Settings and default to the familiar, minimal behavior until you enable them.
